_readme: Hand-written additions merged on top of the extracted rules data at load time.
Use this for content the upstream data is missing — most notably the class-specific
talent trees it references but never defines (Dark Side Devotee, Force Adept, Force Item,
Sith, Expert Pilot, Gunner, Knight's Resolve, Piracy, Military Tactics).
Add the talent itself under `features`, then list its id under the tree in `talentTrees`.
A tree stops being marked incomplete as soon as it has at least one talent.
Nothing here is validated against the books — it is whatever you type.
Icons: drop a file in public/icons/features/ (or classes/, weapons/) and name it here:
Only listed icons are rendered, so a missing file can never show as a broken image.
_comment_lightsaber_chain: Saga Edition has two separate chains. The Elite Trooper one in Weapon Master chooses a
weapon group and is correct as imported — nothing here touches it. The Jedi Knight one in
Duelist is lightsaber-only: Greater Weapon Specialization (lightsabers), CR p.218, whose
prerequisites are the other lightsaber talents and nothing else.
The import gave the Duelist entry the Elite Trooper talent's content: the name lost its
(lightsabers), the description was the generic 'choose a weapon group' text, specType made
it ask which group, and the prerequisites pointed at the generic ids, which the Jedi path
never grants. So a Jedi 7 / Jedi Knight 5 holding the whole lightsaber chain was told it
lacked Weapon Specialization and Greater Weapon Focus. Restored below to the real talent,
matching how its siblings weapon-specialization-lightsabers (CR p.41) and
Juyo, Tràkata and Vaapad named the generic Weapon Specialization the same way, so the
lightsaber forms were shut too. They now name the lightsaber talent.
The Elite Trooper chain is not for lightsabers — that is what the Duelist tree is for.
Greater Weapon Specialization already listed the five groups without lightsabers, but its
tree-mate Greater Weapon Focus offered all seven, so an Elite Trooper could focus in
lightsabers and then never specialize. Both now offer the same five.

greater-weapon-specialization-lightsaber.name: Greater Weapon Specialization (lightsabers)
description: You gain a +2 bonus on melee damage rolls with Lightsabers. This bonus stacks with the bonus granted by the Weapon Specialization (Lightsabers) talent.
greater-weapon-specialization-lightsaber.prerequisites: Greater Weapon Focus (lightsabers), Weapon Focus (lightsabers) feat, Weapon Specialization (lightsabers).
